_design.pattern: durable copy of the ledger's running balances (S14 balance read model)

items.balance: accountId=<account> shardNo=<n> | currency, balanceMinor, version, projectedAt (ISO)

accessPatterns: project a journal line: PutItem IF attribute_not_exists(version) OR version < :v (absolute value, version-guarded)
read a seller balance: GetItem accountId + shardNo 0; read a logical account: Query accountId (all shards)
note: the range key is `shardNo`, not `shard`: `shard` is a DynamoDB reserved word and the platform's test cleanup projects key names unescaped
_design.why: absolute value plus a version makes replay, duplication and reordering harmless; no TTL: the copy survives a loss of the hot store and is rebuilt from the topic or from AccountBalance
